level_1_constraints: Exactly one native subgroup of 32 lanes cooperates on one output row.
K is partitioned lane-stride 32 and reduced within that subgroup.
No logical Split-K64/128 search is part of this parent study.
No fusion with other semantic nodes.
Materialization occurs once before measured inference; zero per-token CPU model math.
No GPU-assisted materialization in this study.
Logical Q4_K value domain is preserved: q nibbles, FP16 d/dmin, integer scale/min semantics must reconstruct exactly.
Reorder and metadata duplication are allowed; exact layout must be frozen in a child implementation lock before any fresh performance execution.
B retains serial k=0..18943 accumulation order; materialization must not introduce additional K parallelism.

primary.acquisition: Calibrated Vulkan timestamps around the 14 Q4_K FFN-down dispatches; instrument identically in all four arms.
primary.per_attempt: For each of 31 decode steps, sum the 14 Q4-down dispatch durations; take the median of those 31 family sums.
primary.cell_summary: Median across 8 measured paired blocks per workload.

component_oracle.origin: Inherited from I002 proven transfer contract.

correctness.floating_hash_policy: Final hidden/logit hashes are recorded but not required bit-identical because Split-K changes FP32 accumulation order.
correctness.materialization_gate: For B/AB, independently reconstruct and hash logical Q4_K tuples for all 14 tensors; exact logical tuple equality with source tensors is mandatory before performance execution.

architecture_cost.materialization_time_ms: Measure one-time CPU wall time from source Q4_K bytes to complete RAM execution image, before inference.
architecture_cost.extra_ram_bytes: Exact additional resident bytes attributable to materialized Q4-down image.
architecture_cost.cpu_runtime_rule: No materialization or CPU model math may overlap measured decode.
break_even: N_B_vs_0 = Tmat_B / (L0 - LB) when LB < L0, else infinity/not-reached.
N_AB_vs_A = Tmat_AB / (LA - LAB) when LAB < LA, else infinity/not-reached.
Also report pairwise total-cost crossover N for every non-dominated arm pair.

timing_campaign.warmup: One unmeasured complete inference per arm/workload before measured blocks.
timing_campaign.balance_property: Each arm appears in each ordinal position exactly twice.

effect_decomposition.latency_symbols: L0, LA, LB, LAB are workload-specific cell latency estimates.

additive_ms.sign: Positive gain is better; positive G_INT means synergistic latency reduction.

effect_decomposition.uncertainty: 10,000 paired bootstrap resamples over the 8 measured blocks, separately per workload; report 95% percentile CI for latency ratios and gain contrasts.
effect_decomposition.pooling: Workload-specific results are primary. Cross-workload geometric means are descriptive and may not override opposite workload directions.
